Head c2fc72576ad1f007e3c44e4cf09481b4a169f0b9, branch codex/bug-2213. Ignored/untracked objects remain fail-closed through the existing no-excludes ls-files check. Home-ledger trust/coverage is unchanged, as the operator clarified; new regression proves newly excluding and malformed ledger updates still refuse. HEAD/ref/worktree stability unchanged.

Local gate:mandate_251 passed/0 failed/1 ignored (existing local corpus replay); final check-ci-fast34/34. All four new BUG-2213 regressions passed. Updated the older timing-record snapshot test to allow timing-only dirt and still reject object dirt. Initial magic-pathspec draft was corrected after a real Git probe showed inherited GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1 hides it; final plain-pathspec regression covers literal/glob/noglob/icase modes with per-command env only.

Local gates preceded clean rebase onto current main by aida ship BUG-2213 --no-merge. CI/independent review pending; no author verdict or merge. Detailed test trail is in PR body and BUG-2213 comment.
